title: DeepMind's 'Strong AI': It Just Smashed Every Turing Test!
description:
It's official: DeepMind just changed *everything*! On July 12, 2026, their new AGI system officially reached 'Strong AI', demonstrating human-level intelligence by passing any Turing test with advanced cognitive abilities, creative problem-solving, and nuanced communication. This pivotal development has ignited global discussions about AI's future and the concept of the singularity. Concerns immediately surfaced regarding potential job displacement and humanity's long-term path.
